pathforge_fit_adaptation: Outside demand shows users want help iterating visual prompts and composition for image/video outputs. This adapts that need into an offline, deterministic browser studio where a user types a thumbnail/poster idea, picks crop ratio/style/subject emphasis, compares three editable layout cards, checks tiny-size readability, and copies a shot/crop checklist without generating images or calling hosted AI.

steps.prompt_exact: I need a small offline single-file HTML studio for planning YouTube thumbnails/poster crops: type the idea, choose ratio, crop style, and subject emphasis, then compare three editable layout cards, score tiny-size readability, and copy a practical shot/crop checklist I can use on my phone.
steps.response_summary: Claude created an offline thumbnail/poster crop planning studio with brief inputs, ratio/crop/emphasis controls, three editable layout cards, tiny-size readability previews, and copyable shot checklist.
